title: The scalar glueball on center-vortex-removed SU(2) lattice ensembles: a data note
description: Short hep-lat data note with data and code. The zero-momentum 0++ glueball correlator and the static potential are measured on SU(2) Wilson-action ensembles at beta 2.3, 2.4 and 2.5 on original, center-projected and vortex-removed (de Forcrand-D'Elia) links in direct maximal center gauge. The cleanest point in the data set is beta 2.4: the vortex-removed 0++ mass is volume independent between 12^4 and 16^4 (ratio 0.98(4)), 2.40(8) sqrt(sigma) in the note's own string-tension unit and 2.52(8) in the literature unit, 0.71(4) of the original glueball mass, from one gauge copy. There the short-time string-tension estimator gives zero, and long-time estimators (reanalysis after referee review) are consistent with zero only at the largest distances resolved. At beta 2.5 the mass is also volume independent, but the pre-registered short-time premise check fails (residual about 0.21 of the original string tension) and is not removed by the best of 16 gauge copies. The pre-registered combined outcome is inconclusive. Small lattices, SU(2) only, three couplings, no continuum statement. Data CC BY 4.0; code in code/ MIT.
